Rhea (CSM): Kicking off Arcadia Health QBR prep. Primary asks: concise token burn snapshot, two cost scenarios (embed pilot spike + conservative growth), onboarding gaps, and a short enablement plan. Can we get daily last-60d and dollarized forecasts?
Omar (FinOps): Need committed credits left + baseline $/mo. Propose soft alert at +30% vs baseline, critical at +55% or credits <10%. Also want an emergency throttle plan for embeddings.
Tess (Data): I can pull it. Will exclude dev keys and bucket daily by feature+model. SQL: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) d, feature, SUM(tokens) t FROM usage WHERE account='arcadia' AND ts >= now()-interval '60 days' AND tags NOT LIKE '%dev%' GROUP BY d,feature ORDER BY d;``` ETA ~90m.
Ben (AM): FYI customer will pilot a semantic search POC next week. They asked for a "cost-safety" checklist before enabling non-prod traffic.
Rhea (CSM): For the deck: slide1 = current burn + model mix, slide2 = Scenario A: 2x embed for 30d (pilot), slide3 = Scenario B: steady 6% monthly growth for 3 months, slide4 = alert/runbook + enablement one-pager.
Omar (FinOps): Ops knobs I want in the one-pager: batch size recommendations, prefix caching, embedding dim guidance, and a console toggle to snooze alerts during demos. I'll draft a quick ops play by EOD.
Tess (Data): Raw last30d: gen=53,700,000 tokens, embed=16,900,000 tokens. Uploading CSV to /shared/qbr/arcadia_tokens_1758.csv and will run the two forecast variants mapping tokens->$ with mix: gen $0.0006/token, embed $0.0011/token.
qbr-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/arcadia_tokens_1758.csv. Automated baseline forecast (+10%) appended.
Rhea (CSM): @Tess add two outputs: a) one-month 2x embed spike with $ delta, b) 3-month steady 6% growth. Include runway (months) at current credit balance.
Tess (Data): Will include charts and a short note if dev/test traffic was filtered. ETA 2h.
Ben (AM): I'll prepare a 30-45min enablement: 25m demo (batching + KV cache + prompt templates) + 10m ops Q&A. Tentatively Thurs 4pm PT. Will confirm with customer and collect dev key timestamps to help Tess filter.
Omar (FinOps): Created monitoring config `alerts/arcadia/budget` in staging, wired to #cs-costs. Added `snooze_window` flag and test webhook. I added an emergency throttle policy: throttle embed QPS to safe tier + notify CSM/AM.
Rhea (CSM): Action items: Tess (final CSVs + scenario charts), Omar (one-pager + monitoring config + playbook), Ben (confirm enablement + collect dev timestamps), Rhea (assemble QBR deck). I'll circulate draft by tomorrow 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
qbr-bot: QBR checklist item added: "Arcadia cost scenarios + enablement one-pager" assigned to Rhea, due in 16 hours.
